`marked-17.0.5.tgz` packages the MIT-licensed Marked 17.0.5 distribution
from Codex's installed dependency runtime (bundle 26.1017.11052).
The local tarball keeps builds reproducible when the npm registry is unavailable.
Its SHA-512 integrity is recorded in `package-lock.json`; source and license are
included in the archive. Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked.
